integrity: Includes an exact-rational reproducibility script; proof of the unrestricted assertions is mathematical rather than experimental.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted wheels and one half-lazy step only; no higher powers, arbitrary laziness, or weighted wheels. Exact norm is an O(m) rational maximum; no uniqueness of all extremizers or independent mathematical validation.
title: Interval extremizers and a 29-rim Gini–Dobrushin crossover for lazy wheel walks
